subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about buying US install volume for {Brand} against a retention target. The one point worth repeating: we optimize toward the retained D7 user, modeled from real returning players through SKAdNetwork conversion values and server-to-server postbacks on session-return, so the cohort carries into the build-and-harvest loop where the season pass actually monetizes. In our US casual runs that lands around a 24% D7 read. If it helps, I can share the retention curve we are holding. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate retained D7 proof
